# Opotek
> Electronics, firmware and mechanical engineering services for hardware
> product development, from concept to production. Based in Barcelona, Spain.
> Led by consulting engineer Oriol Pascual with a team of highly capable engineers.
> Every project is quoted individually after a short discovery call.
